findings.basis: Carrier 311-03 is a two-digit MNC under MCC 311. US SIMs carry three-digit MNCs, and the MediaTek vendor.xml entry (mnc="03") is matched by exact string (DefaultCarrierConfigService.java:360-364), so it never applied to a real SIM and its carrier cannot be identified.
findings.effect: rtt_supported_while_roaming_bool (CarrierConfigManager.java:10988-10992, default false at :12197) only matters while roaming, and only together with rtt_supported_bool. When roaming, the AOSP ImsStack's ImsRegistrationTracker.isRttSupported returns this key instead of true (ImsRegistrationTracker.java:585-598), so it decides whether the roaming normal REGISTER carries TEXT (ImsRegistrationTracker.java:419-424). The native AosCondition.IsRttSupported returns it when the cellular network is roaming (AosCondition.cpp:998-1011), and that feeds the TTY-mode deregistration rule (AosCondition.cpp:813-826, 1027-1031); AosNConfiguration.cpp:1569-1570 loads it. The emergency registration ignores it, because AosHandleEmergencyMtc.cpp:56 reads only rtt_supported_bool. Telephony's TelecomAccountRegistry.isCarrierAllowRttWhenRoaming (TelecomAccountRegistry.java:866-873, 1139-1154) and AccessibilitySettingsFragment.java:292-296 read it too, but only behind config_support_rtt, which is false on this ROM. Telephony's own RTT gates also need R.bool.config_support_rtt, which is false in this tree (packages/services/Telephony/res/values/config.xml:234-235, config_support_simless_emergency_rtt false at :259-261) with no overlay in device/samsung/x1s, device/samsung/universal9830-common or rom-repos/android_vendor_extra: PhoneInterfaceManager.isRttSupported/isRttEnabled (PhoneInterfaceManager.java:7995-8035), the PhoneAccount CAPABILITY_RTT bit (TelecomAccountRegistry.java:441-446, 1102-1155) and the accessibility RTT switch (AccessibilitySettingsFragment.java:267-276) are all off, so the stock Dialer never offers or upgrades to RTT (DialerCall.java:1024-1052). Telecom still creates RTT streams for an incoming RTT call (CallsManager.java:1809-1816) and for an outgoing emergency call when the calling app passes EXTRA_START_CALL_WITH_RTT, ignoring the account capability (CallsManager.java:2650-2662). Read on the LineageOS 23.2 tree; the phone runs 24.0, whose config_support_rtt was not checked. The OCD ImsStack fork (branch ocd) is byte-identical to the tree in every ImsStack file cited.
findings.risk: No real SIM is known to match this profile. Its rtt_supported_bool is held in candidate 27, which makes this key inert for it, and Android's default false loses nothing.
